name: Kbd
whenToUse: Showing a keyboard key or shortcut in text, menus, tooltips and help: ⌘ K, Esc, ?.

anatomy.description: one Kbd per key; combinations are several Kbd side by side.

do.caption: One cap per key, inside a sentence that says what it does.

dont.caption: A whole phrase in one cap — the key styling stops meaning “a key”.

a11y: Kbd only shows the shortcut; the shortcut must actually work and be described in text.
